# §5 Commerce Analytics — Highlight Candidates

1. **$6.6M eCat GMV across 2,608 orders** — Trailing 12-month eCat ordering delivered $6.6M at a $2,526 average order value, with a near-even 50/50 iPad–eCat Online order split by volume. [→ §commerce]
2. **iPad drives 66% of GMV** — Despite nearly equal order counts (1,315 vs. 1,293), iPad orders carry a 1.9× AOV premium ($3,323 vs. $1,715) and account for two-thirds of eCat order value in the trailing 12 months. [→ §commerce]
3. **Highly diversified buyer base** — No single buyer exceeds 3.6% of eCat GMV; top 5 buyers represent just 14.3% of total — well below concentration thresholds — minimizing single-account revenue risk. [→ §commerce]
4. **98.9% confirmed order rate** — Nearly all 2,608 orders flow straight to confirmed status in the trailing 12 months, indicating a clean, low-friction ordering workflow with minimal processing overhead. [→ §commerce]

## Priority Action Candidate
- **MEDIUM**: Expand quote workflow adoption — with only 27 quote orders (1.0% of volume) in the trailing 12 months, the quote workflow is significantly under-leveraged; increasing quote usage among reps could help capture more complex, higher-value transactions through the platform [HYPOTHETICAL]. [→ §commerce]
